subject.title: fix(chat): preserve explicit current-source sends in Control UI history

question: Should a successful outbound result whose resolved channel, account, target, and thread equal the current source be treated as authoritative evidence for projecting that explicit send into the current Control UI session history?
rationale: The implementation is coherent and well-tested, but accepting this marker defines a cross-path session-association trust boundary whose correctness and permanence require owner intent rather than automated judgment alone.

options.title: Accept the structured route marker
options.body: Refresh the branch and merge once an owner confirms that outbound resolved-route identity is the canonical source for this history projection.

options.title: Require transcript-owned mirroring
options.body: Keep the PR open and redesign the fix so the outbound delivery is first represented by an authoritative transcript mirror rather than projector-only result metadata.

options.title: Limit the projection scope
options.body: Narrow the change to a smaller set of channel or route shapes until broader account and thread equivalence has additional production evidence.

recommendation.title: Accept the structured route marker
recommendation.body: Refresh the branch and merge once an owner confirms that outbound resolved-route identity is the canonical source for this history projection.

likelyOwner.reason: The available history most strongly connects this person to the Gateway, channel-delivery, and agent-send boundary involved in the decision.
